status: EXTRACTED + COMPARED — requires review before ingestion
method: Official vtu.ac.in scheme PDFs -> pdfjs extract -> table parse -> compare against packages/vtu-catalogue/data/vtu-2022.json. No value was taken from any third-party site.
knownLimitations: Semester attribution comes from the nearest preceding "<ROMAN> SEMESTER" heading. It yielded 0 rows for semester 7 and 105 for semester 8 across the 5-8 documents, which is implausible: semester is UNRELIABLE for the 5-8 range and must be re-derived before ingestion.
12 rows are marked parseConfidence=SUSPECT (CIE+SEE != Total, a column shift). They are excluded from the comparison and must not be ingested.
Codes ending in a stream placeholder (printed as x in the PDF, e.g. BPLCK105x) are NOT canonical course codes. All 5 credit conflicts below are on such codes.
Elective classification, module titles, objectives, outcomes and prerequisites were NOT extracted: they live in the separate syllabus PDFs, not the scheme tables.
Only 29 of roughly 400 official PDFs were harvested. Coverage is the major branches; it is not the whole university.

reconciliation.statement: 556 = 218 present + 315 missing + 11 (2025, no GradTools counterpart) + 12 SUSPECT (excluded)
reconciliation.overlapNote: creditConflicts is NOT a fourth bucket. The 5 conflict ROWS span 2 distinct codes over 4 course rows, and every one is a SUBSET of the 218 corroborated-present bucket (a conflict requires the course to exist on both sides). Adding 5 to 315+218 double-counts, which is what produced the apparent 18-record shortfall.
reconciliation.whyTheEarlierArithmeticFailed: 315 + 218 + 5 = 538 treated conflicts as a separate bucket and omitted the 2025 and SUSPECT records entirely. The true remainder is 23 (11 + 12), not 18.

suspectSchemeBreakdown.note: All 12 SUSPECT rows are 2025. The 2022 extraction produced zero suspect rows.
